prompt: A single vast elder mushroom tree of the pale forest, painterly vanilla RimWorld plant sprite, realistic, clean dark outline, transparent background, seen from above-front at a gentle angle. A towering pale cap, tree-scale, dwarfing a person, on a thick stalk. Pale, washed-out colouring throughout: bone-white, grey-cream and faint grey-green tones. A heavy, visible pall of spores settled as a low pale cloud on the ground beneath the cap. Pale hyphae spread outward from the base of the stalk across the ground as a branching network of long, thin, distinct white-grey threads, forking and reaching well beyond the base, clearly readable as a root mat at normal play size. The stalk base meets the hyphae network where the threads fan out in every direction.
